top_choice_rationale: Circuit QED (Blais, Wallraff, Schoelkopf) is a sharply defined, twenty-year-replicated achievement: coherent single-photon strong coupling to an artificial atom plus dispersive readout. It is distinct from the 2025 macroscopic-tunnelling prize, and the narrow citation keeps the three-name allocation defensible, though Girvin and Huang remain an acknowledged exposure. The optical lattice clock (P002) is a close second with tighter two-name credit but sits in an already honoured precision-frequency lineage; the Higgs trio (P003) has a real credit problem with Gianotti and the collaboration structure; no award is the weakest outcome given two mature options.
